description: Ministry of Lands - Appointed Mr. K.M.Ariyarathne, Mr. Siripala Kanewela, Mr. D.K.Manamperi & Mr. P.M.Seneviratne as acquiring officers under the Metro Colombo Urban Development Project from 02.10.2016 to 02.10.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically concerns land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It appoints officers to function as Acquiring Officers for land acquisition duties under the Metro Colombo Urban Development Project. The core subject matter is land acquisition and property-related administrative appointments, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While it mentions government personnel appointments, the primary focus and context are land acquisition, making Type 4 the appropriate classification rather than a government personnel type.
